证据中未明确说明 Transformer 的 base 和 big 模型分别使用多少块 GPU。仅提到所有模型均在“一台配备 8 NVIDIA P100 GPU 的机器”上训练 [1]，但未区分 base 和 big 模型的 GPU 数量。因此，无法确定二者是否使用相同数量的 GPU。

关于训练时长：
- Transformer (base)：训练 100,000 步，约 12 小时 [4]。
- Transformer (big)：训练 300,000 步，约 3.5 天 [4]。

但证据未说明“big”模型是否使用 8 块 GPU，仅说明“所有模型”在 8 块 GPU 上训练 [1]，因此无法确认 big 模型是否使用 8 块 GPU。若需精确回答，需补充证据中关于 big 模型 GPU 数量的明确说明，但当前证据不足。

综上：
- base 模型：训练时长 12 小时，GPU 数量未明确说明。
- big 模型：训练时长 3.5 天，GPU 数量未明确说明。

[1]、[4]

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.text:
On the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, Our big transformer model (Transformer
(big) in Table 2) outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more
than 2.0 BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4. The configuration of this
model is listed in the bottom line of Table 3. Training took 3.5 days on 8 P100 GPUs. Even our base
model surpasses all previously published models and ensembles, at a fraction of the training cost of
any of the previous best models.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.text:
Table 2 summarizes our results and compares our translation quality and training costs to other model
architectures from the literature. We estimate the number of floating point operations used to train a
model by multiplying the training time, the number of GPUs used, and an estimate of the sustained
single-precision floating-point capacity of each GPU 3.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.text:
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs. For our base models using
the hyperparameters described throughout the paper, each training step took about 0.4 seconds. We
trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours. For our big models,(described on the
bottom line of table 3), step time was 1.0 seconds, and the models were trained for 300,000 steps or
3.5 days.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.text:
On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our big model achieves a BLEU score of 41.0,
outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than 1/4 the training cost of the
previous state-of-the-art model. The Transformer (big) model trained for English-to-French used
dropout rate Pdrop = 0.1, instead of 0.3.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.text:
In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead
relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization and can reach a new state of the art in
translation quality after being trained for as little as twelve hours on eight P100 GPUs.
